title: Payment Terms and Rounding for Wayfare Rentals Charges
content:
These payment terms apply alike to every Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals) class, from the Economy Sedan to the Premium Sedan.

**Term 1. Order of payment.** Each rental charge is paid from these sources, in this order:

1. a deduction from the driver's earnings;
2. the card on file.

**Term 2. Timing of the card charge.** Any part of a charge not covered by earnings is charged to the card on file the day after the weekly deduction.

**Term 3. Rounding.** Every computed rental amount is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end of its computation; no intermediate figure is rounded.

| Term | Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan, Hybrid Sedan, Electric Sedan, Midsize SUV, Minivan and Premium Sedan |
|---|---|
| First source of payment | Driver's earnings |
| Second source of payment | Card on file |
| Card charge date | The day after the weekly deduction |
| Rounding | Half up, to the cent, once at the end |

**Hypothetical illustrations.**

- A computed amount of $12.345 is rounded half up to $12.35; $12.344 becomes $12.34.
- If a hypothetical weekly deduction is taken on a Monday and earnings cover only part of a charge, the uncovered part is charged to the card on file on the Tuesday.
